nodes.description: Constant state variable defining the number of traits (9) used as loop bound for trait generation.
Constant state variable defining the gene table length (40) used as inner loop bound.
External view function that builds a pseudo-random seed from block.difficulty, seed, block.timestamp and nonce, then indexes the genes/races tables to return a uint[9] traits array.
block.timestamp is used as entropy inside the keccak256 seed derivation, making the outcome miner/validator-influenceable.
Weak randomness construction: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, seed, block.timestamp, nonce++)) used as the trait RNG source.
Caller-supplied nonce parameter of roll(), post-incremented inside the RNG loop.
Local pseudo-random value re-hashed each iteration and used for modulo selection of traits.
Local index selecting the race row used to pick the trait gene columns.
Local uint[9] array holding the generated trait values that is ultimately returned.
Per-trait local value derived from randomSeed modulo the gene boundary table.
Outer loop counter over races and traits.
Inner loop counter over MAX_LENGTH gene entries.
Local lookup table of gene boundary/value rows used to translate traitSeed into trait values.
Local lookup table of race thresholds and race ids used to derive traits[0].

edges.reason: Caller-supplied seed parameter is consumed by roll() when building the pseudo-random seed.
Caller-supplied nonce parameter is consumed (and post-incremented) by roll() inside the RNG derivation.
block.timestamp is packed directly into the keccak256 input of the randomness operation, creating timestamp dependency.
roll() executes the weak randomness operation that depends on block.timestamp for every trait draw.
The unsafe randomness operation produces the randomSeed local that drives all trait selection.
randomSeed is reduced modulo the gene boundary table to derive the per-trait traitSeed.
randomSeed is compared against the races thresholds to choose the race index r.
The selected race index r determines races[0][i] written into traits[0].
Gene table lookups supply the trait values stored into the traits array.
Race table thresholds determine the race value written into traits[0].
Outer loop counter i indexes the genes table rows for each trait.
Inner loop counter j indexes the genes table columns while searching for the trait value.
NUM_TRAITS bounds the outer trait generation loop inside roll().
MAX_LENGTH bounds the inner gene search loop inside roll().
roll() writes and returns the generated traits array.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter seed is only used as input to roll() and has no independent state, so it folds into the roll function node.
Parameter nonce is only used (and incremented) inside roll()'s RNG derivation and folds into the roll function node.
Local randomSeed exists solely to hold the output of the weak randomness operation, so it merges into unsafe_randomness.
Local r is an intermediate race index computed and consumed entirely within roll().
Local traits array is the return value assembled by roll() and has no separate lifetime.
Local traitSeed is an intermediate modulo value used only inside roll()'s trait selection loop.
Local i is a loop counter scoped to roll()'s iteration logic.
Local j is a loop counter scoped to roll()'s inner gene search loop.
Local genes lookup table is instantiated and read only inside roll() to produce traits.
Local races lookup table is instantiated and read only inside roll() to produce traits[0].
